title: A reading correction keeps both values (no audit screen in v1)
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in, on the build under test, as a service advisor with the view customers and create and edit customers permissions.
  2. An asset enrolled on a schedule (standard enrolment steps).
  3. The asset's mileage card shows a recorded value (e.g. 342,417).
custom_steps:
1. Click Enter mileage and save a corrected value (e.g. 342,500); read the mileage card.
  2. Look in the product for any screen showing the previous value, who changed it and when.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The mileage card shows the corrected value and the services that depend on it update.
  • That both values were kept with their times and authors, and that a later moved due date can be traced back to the reading, cannot be checked by hand in v1 — no screen shows the audit; it is for a developer or automated check. Pass or fail on what you can see, and write "audit not checked by hand" in the result comment.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780, story SV-10576 (S21, The audit trail), Chunk 1 MR (Confluence 886931488) as edited 5 October 2026, S21 (S21-R4, S21-E2, S21-N3); read 6 Oct 2026. Source-verified 6 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S9-E2: “Entering a reading here recalculates every dependent service immediately”
  • S21-R4: “A reading correction will keep both values, each with its timestamp and author”
  • S21-E2: “A due date that moved weeks after a new reading must be traceable to the reading that moved it”
  • S21-N3: “No screen shows the audit in v1”
